title: BalancerPooler MEV sandwich on donation via zero slippage
severity_rationale: Downgraded from H-03. Balancer V3 DONATION does not mint BPT, so minBptAmountOut=0 is technically correct. The real issue is MEV sandwich on predictable donations -- a value leak with external requirements.
description: minBptAmountOut=0 in AddLiquidityParams with DONATION kind. Attacker acquires BPT before donation, donation increases BPT backing value, attacker sells BPT after.
impact: Value extraction from every BalancerPooler dispatch via MEV sandwich
recommendation: Consider if DONATION truly needs slippage protection; add private transaction mechanism or commit-reveal
root_cause: Zero slippage protection on pool donation
note: Balancer V3 DONATION does not mint BPT. minBptAmountOut=0 is technically correct for this liquidity kind.
